import sqlite3
import csv
import sys

def export_users_to_csv(output_file):
    """Export all user records to CSV file."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect('users.db')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Get all users with all fields
    cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM users')
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    
    # Get column names
    cursor.execute('PRAGMA table_info(users)')
    columns = [col[1] for col in cursor.fetchall()]
    
    # Write to CSV
    with open(output_file, 'w', newline='') as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f)
        writer.writerow(columns)
        writer.writerows(rows)
    
    conn.close()
    print(f'Exported {len(rows)} users to {output_file}')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    # Allow output path from command line argument
    output_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'users_export.csv'
    export_users_to_csv(output_path)
